garmin - forerunner 170 gps smartwatch 4.description: For runners looking to get more out of their workouts, there’s Forerunner 170 — the easy-to-use GPS running smartwatch with a bright AMOLED touchscreen display. Get features such as pace, distance and heart rate alongside more advanced training and recovery metrics. Use the training readiness feature to know when you’re ready for a productive workout, and use training status to know if you’re training productively. For those who have a specific goal in mind or follow more structured training, there’s Garmin Coach personalized training plans — choose from beginner level with run/walk workouts and fewer runs per week all the way up to plans for more experienced runners who want to train at a higher volume and intensity. With up to 10 days of battery life in smartwatch mode and up to 20 hours in GPS mode, the Forerunner 170 smartwatch not only keeps up on your runs but also gives you a more complete picture of your health, day after day.
